blocks.html: DFA Consular Office now Open in Calasiao, Pangasinan

The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) Consular Office is now open at 2nd floor of Robinsons Place Pangasinan, located along McArthur Highway, Barangay San Miguel, Calasiao. This newest facility which is under the Robinsons Malls’ Lingkod Pinoy Center will offer the following services: processing of application of new passports, and renewal of passports. Shoppers and mallers alike can also have their passports extended, or have these certified. DFA Consular Office-Calasiao will be the 10th satellite office to open under the Robinsons Malls’ Lingkod Pinoy Center. Other DFA Consular Offices are located in Robinsons Starmills Pampanga, Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Place GenSan, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Place Iloilo, Robinsons Place Bacolod, Robinsons Place Palawan, Robinsons Place Butuan and Robinsons Place Dumaguete. More DFA Consular offices are expected to open in several Robinsons Malls located nationwide.

Macanlalay (rightmost), DFA and Robinsons Malls officers during the ribbon cutting rites and inauguration of the DFA Consular Office in Robinsons Place Pangasinan.
